scope: Source-only review of the exact B416 runner and real-fit CPU-audit helper, following the separate trainer-diff review

checks.result: BC freezes A, AC freezes B, AB freezes C, and C freezes A/B. The runner changes training eligibility only; the full ABC implementation remains the deployed model. The eight literal variant/stage command fixtures agree with the trainer argument parser.

All four arms use own future-policy caches from own25 prefixes, 902 TRAIN/128 validation, protected old4 initialization, seed42, oracle search supervision, budgeted action ranking, action write verification, no pair calibration, lr/weight decay 1e-4, and threshold .03. Batch416 gives three optimizer steps per epoch: M0 three epochs/nine updates and full sixty epochs/one hundred eighty updates.

The paired-cache and provisional source-review gates precede training. Full additionally requires the actual all-four-arm M0 acceptance with B416, three epochs, and nine steps. Literal gate execution rejects missing receipts and each incorrect required field. This source-review receipt is not an M0 acceptance receipt.

An existing output directory prevents an accidental repeated run. Private cwd/PYTHONPATH and explicit trainer/model import-path checks select the isolated research package. set -euo pipefail leaves training_completed/job_completed markers after successful trainer completion only. These two markers denote training completion; this runner launches no continuous-video evaluation.

The actual auditor requires empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and private cwd, imports the private sources, loads tensors on CPU, disables autograd, and asserts CUDA remains uninitialized. It checks the existing staging/source invariant before and after, plus the protected parent's existing known identity. No new source-binding mechanism was requested by this review.

All four arms require actual config/completion/metrics/log/checkpoint/output/terminal artifacts. The audit checks cache provenance, 881/98 disjoint sequence partitions, own teacher/prefix epoch25, matching jobs, expected B416 log triplets and real optimizer counts, finite losses/gradients, active changes, frozen unchanged receipts, and frozen-C1 gradient evidence. Eight stage/variant log fixtures accept expected records and reject wrong steps, frozen gradients, and frozen changes.

The retained best is the earliest maximum held-out utility, matching strict-improvement training selection. The auditor verifies the full epoch history, selected/last metrics and checkpoint arguments. Selected checkpoints compare all 25 state tensors against the parent/C1; frozen groups stay exact, active groups must differ only when best_epoch is nonzero. Eight source fixtures accept best0 equal to the parent and trained active-group changes, while rejecting incorrect frozen/active differences.

The actual auditor strictly loads the parent and selected model, verifies all eight retained C1 tensors, frozen/trainable group counts, parent epoch0 validation replay, selected-best validation metrics, and all 21 saved fields across 128 validation outputs. Integer/boolean outputs require exact equality; float outputs use the already-established float32-epsilon tolerance. Cached evaluation uses the existing dataset-label utility/IoU implementation. This is CPU replay using the reviewed evaluator, not an independent reimplementation of metrics.

Terminal updates are explicitly labeled as source-linked real receipt/log evidence, with no retained last weights. Selected-best tensor differences are measured separately. The final acceptance file is written only after all four arms pass and before/after source/parent checks finish. No continuous or native metric improvement is claimed.

The comparison limitation is explicit: new arms use B416 while the existing joint-ABC reference used B384. This diagnostic does not isolate module freezing from the batch-size change and is not a completed eight-combination paper ablation or root-cause proof.
